paraphrase: Leave the mind uncontrived and it is self-liberated; whatever thoughts arise, look at them and they are self-liberated; the four faults (of deviation) are self-liberated; the fruit is the four kāyas, spontaneously present — ground, path and fruit held together like the two halves of an amulet box.
notes: Reference from memory; the text is not available locally. Low: reconstructed from memory of the pattern.
